desc: Build a brute-force minimax solver with memoization for tiny states (N≤5, A_i≤5) and exhaustively compare against the candidate rule, reporting mismatches.
Finalize the exact winning criterion: N=1→Fennec; N=2→Snuke; N=3→Fennec iff any A_i odd; N≥4→Fennec iff odd-count is odd (validated exhaustively, exact values beyond parity do not matter).
Implement final O(N) solution reading stdin, counting odd A_i, applying the criterion, and printing Fennec/Snuke (parity-only, no overflow); matches all three samples.
